itemized.notes: 18-page PDF in which every EVEN page is a blank verso - the substantive pages are the odd ones. p1 cover (year-end box checked, signed 1-31-14, clerk RECEIVED JAN 31 2014, office 'County Council At-Large C'), p3 Summary Page, p5 blank Itemized Contributions form ('See Attached'), p7 the contributions attachment ('Jim Bradley Council Council At Large C / Income Detail for Period ended December 31, 2013', printed LANDSCAPE, rotated 90 deg CLOCKWISE to read - the opposite sign from other landscape attachments in this corpus), p9 blank Itemized Expenditures form ('See Attached'), p11 the expenditures attachment ('Jim Bradley for County Council At-Large C / Expense Detail...'). Pages 13, 15 and 17 are the SECOND-ACCOUNT set - 'Summary Page - Other Campaign Accounts', 'Itemized Contributions from Other Campaign Accounts' and 'Itemized Expenditures from Other Campaign Accounts' - and all three are ENTIRELY BLANK (no figures, no totals): an honest zero for a schedule that is not Schedule A/B and is outside this transcription's scope. The contributions attachment splits names into a surname/organization column and a given-name/officer column; donor_raw joins them as printed. Street lines are covered by a solid black county redaction box; city/state print outside the box and are the only geography taken. The contributions attachment also carries Occupation and Employer columns (Labor Union, Sheriff/Salt Lake County, Economist/Energy Strategies, Food Distribution/Nicholas & Company, Executive Producer/Self, Public Administration/Salt Lake County) for which the per-row contract has no slot. Four of the ten expenditures are LOAN REPAYMENTS to the candidate and three are donations out to other campaigns.
